property_summary: The total number of successful _tos transfers initiated by transfer() must equal _tos.length; the mutant skips the last element, so the number of successful external calls is _tos.length-1 whenever _tos.length >= 2.
change_summary: Replace the loop condition `i<_tos.length` with `i<_tos.length-1` to skip the last transfer, changing final token balances.
